This page lists 90 Notion keyboard shortcuts for macOS, grouped by area. They come from the community `notion.keyly` template for [Keyly](/), a free, open-source menu bar app: install the template once, then double-tap `⇪ Caps Lock` in Notion to see them next to the shortcuts Keyly reads from the app's menus.

## Install the template

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/main/scripts/install-templates.sh | bash -s -- -t notion.keyly
```

This saves the template to `~/.config/keyly/templates/notion.keyly`. It targets `/Applications/Notion.app`; if Notion lives elsewhere on your Mac, [update the app path](/configuration/templates/). New to Keyly? Start with [Getting Started](/getting-started/).

## Navigation

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘P` | Open search / Quick Find |
| `⌘K` | Open search / Quick Find |
| `⌘F` | Search in page |
| `⌘L` | Copy page URL |
| `⌘[` | Go back |
| `⌘]` | Go forward |
| `⌃⇧K` | Previous database page (peek view) |
| `⌃⇧J` | Next database page (peek view) |
| `⌘⇧U` | Go up one level in hierarchy |

## Desktop

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘N` | New page |
| `⌘⇧N` | New Notion window |
| `⌥⇧+click` | Open page as new window |
| `⌘+click` | Open link as new tab |
| `⌘T` | New Notion tab |
| `⌘⇧L` | Toggle dark/light mode |
| `⌘+` | Zoom in |
| `⌘-` | Zoom out |

## Text Formatting

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘B` | Bold |
| `⌘I` | Italic |
| `⌘U` | Underline |
| `⌘⇧S` | Strikethrough |
| `⌘K` | Add link |
| `⌘E` | Inline code |
| `⌘⇧M` | Create comment |
| `⌘⇧H` | Apply last color/highlight |

## Block Types

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘⌥0` | Text block |
| `⌘⌥1` | Heading 1 |
| `⌘⌥2` | Heading 2 |
| `⌘⌥3` | Heading 3 |
| `⌘⌥4` | To-do checkbox |
| `⌘⌥5` | Bulleted list |
| `⌘⌥6` | Numbered list |
| `⌘⌥7` | Toggle list |
| `⌘⌥8` | Code block |
| `⌘⌥9` | New page block |

## Editing

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⏎` | Insert line of text |
| `⇧⏎` | Line break within block |
| `⇥` | Indent / nest content |
| `⇧⇥` | Un-nest content |

## Block Selection

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⎋` | Select current block / Clear selection |
| `⌘A` | Select block cursor is in |
| `↑↓` | Select different block |
| `⇧↑↓` | Expand selection up/down |
| `⌘⇧+click` | Select/deselect entire block |
| `⇧+click` | Select block and all between |

## Block Actions

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌫` | Delete selected blocks |
| `⌘D` | Duplicate blocks |
| `⏎` | Edit text in selected block |
| `⌘/` | Edit or change selected blocks |
| `⌘⇧↑↓←→` | Move selected block |
| `⌘⌥T` | Expand/close all toggles |
| `⌘⏎` | Modify block (open/check/toggle) |
| `⌥+drag` | Duplicate content while dragging |

## Database

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘R` | Fill cells right (table) |
| `⌘D` | Fill cells down (table) |

## Markdown Syntax

Type these followed by space:

+ space       Toggle list

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `* + space` | Bulleted list |
| `- + space` | Bulleted list |
| `1. + space` | Numbered list |
| `[] + space` | To-do checkbox |
| `" + space` | Quote block |
| `---` | Divider |

## Inline Markdown

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `**text**` | Bold |
| `*text*` | Italic |
| `` `text` `` | Inline code |
| `~text~` | Strikethrough |

## Slash Commands

Type / then command name.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `/text` | Text block |
| `/page` | New page |
| `/bullet` | Bulleted list |
| `/num` | Numbered list |
| `/todo` | To-do list |
| `/toggle` | Toggle list |
| `/h1` | Heading 1 |
| `/h2` | Heading 2 |
| `/h3` | Heading 3 |
| `/quote` | Quote block |
| `/div` | Divider |
| `/code` | Code block |
| `/image` | Image |
| `/video` | Video |
| `/embed` | Embed |
| `/duplicate` | Duplicate block |
| `/delete` | Delete block |
| `/toc` | Table of contents |
| `/equation` | Math equation |

## @ Commands

Type @ then:

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `@name` | Mention person |
| `@pagename` | Link to page |
| `@date` | Add date |
| `@remind` | Add reminder |

## Link Commands

Type \[\[ or + then page name.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `[[pagename` | Link to page |
| `+pagename` | Create sub-page |

## Template file

The full [`notion.keyly`](https://github.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/blob/main/templates/notion.keyly) file. Copy it into `~/.config/keyly/templates/` to edit it, or [write your own](/configuration/custom-shortcuts/).
